name: LiveSeal
status: Research preview · no real call yet
mission: A signed seal in live video, checked by the receiver.
missionLines: A signed seal in live video,
flowAlt: Data flow. On the sender: the camera frame is reduced and the face located on the device; every 2 seconds a 32-byte digest of the last 2 seconds is signed with Ed25519; the statement is error-coded and embedded as small shifts in a 32 by 18 grid of cells on three colour planes. Through the call: any call app and codec carry the pixels; the receiver reads a video tile, a captured window or a recording. On the receiver: pilots and soft LDPC decoding recover the statement, the verifier checks key, signature, revocation, session, freshness, replay and content, and a badge turns green only after two valid statements in a row.

nodes: 32x18 cells on Y, Cb and Cr
